issues.legal_issue: A claim that state action infringes a fundamental right to property cannot be maintained before the claimant establishes title where that title is disputed in legally constituted proceedings.
material_facts: The petitioner sought relief under Article 32, alleging infringement of its rights under Articles 19(1)(f) and 31(1) in relation to property it claimed through an assigned leasehold interest.

A proceeding under Section 4(h) of the Bihar Land Reforms Act was pending before the Collector to determine facts bearing on whether the property was subject to the Act and whether the earlier lease could be annulled.
The petitioner’s entitlement to the property depended on the outcome of that inquiry, and its title had not yet been established.
The constitutional validity of Section 4(h) was not challenged.
issues.conclusion: The petitioner could not establish an infringement of its fundamental right to property before its title was established in the pending inquiry; the Article 32 petition was misconceived and was dismissed with costs.
issues.legal_principle: Under Articles 19(1)(f) and 31(1) of the Constitution, a claimant must establish title before complaining that a fundamental right to property has been infringed. If title is disputed and is being adjudicated in legally constituted proceedings, a claim based on that title cannot be advanced until the inquiry establishes it; only then can the question of improper or illegal infringement arise. The pending inquiry was under Section 4(h) of the Bihar Land Reforms Act. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: constitutional_property_right_petition and property_title_disputed and lawful_title_adjudication_pending and title_not_yet_established

predicates.constitutional_property_right_petition: The claimant brought a constitutional proceeding alleging infringement of a fundamental right to property.
predicates.property_title_disputed: The claimant’s title to the property was disputed.
predicates.lawful_title_adjudication_pending: A legally constituted proceeding was pending to determine the claimant’s title or facts on which that title depended.
predicates.title_not_yet_established: The pending proceeding had not established the claimant’s title to the property.

issues.definition: When a claimant brings a constitutional property-right petition while title is disputed, its lawful adjudication is pending, and title has not been established, the claim of infringement is premature.
